name: Sound
intro: PERIGEE is a five-track EP conducted by a coding agent on an Analog Rytm drum machine. Other work includes firmware for Eurorack modules, a browser-based techno loop generator, and LEMON AUDIO, a music platform.

name: Ink
intro: hatch3d turns 3D surfaces into hatching for an AxiDraw pen plotter. InkSight creates reports that help coding agents inspect plotter SVGs.

name: Agents
intro: Lemon Agent is a course on safe coding-agent work. lookout, skiff, nanoclaw, and the rest of the software stack support agents running on the Mac mini in the closet.

name: Play
intro: feltmath is a blackjack and hold'em trainer. Typing Arena is a local multiplayer typing game. BrightPath Global Solutions is a consultancy that does not exist.
